# Nicholas De Souza

> Nicholas De Souza: Toronto solution engineer at Salesforce who builds AI agents and takes them to production. Founder of Digistax and Vowbird.ai.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nicholasdesouza.com/): Career highlights, current projects (Vowbird.ai, Digistax, Holdline), past work and a ten-year career summary.
- [Case studies](https://nicholasdesouza.com/case-studies/): Index of the case studies, with a summary of each: Digistax and Holdline.
- [Digistax case study](https://nicholasdesouza.com/case-studies/digistax/): How Digistax, a prototype software agency, runs every task as a graph of AI agents: orchestrators, nine role agents and a person approving every gate.
  Sections: The whole pipeline; The nine role agents; One request, start to finish; The same desk, on a phone; Anatomy of a job; Two validators who never meet; The graph decides who pays; Design principles
- [Holdline case study](https://nicholasdesouza.com/case-studies/holdline/): Holdline: an ElevenLabs voice agent rebooks every passenger on a cancelled flight at once, in two languages, in under three minutes, with no double bookings.
  Sections: The challenge; The approach; Same call, her language; She said it once; Policy held. He still said yes; One seat, one promise; Architecture; Five passengers resolved in under three minutes; What I learned; Outcome
- [Product screenshot gallery](https://nicholasdesouza.com/gallery.html): Product screenshots from Vowbird.ai, the Digistax agent workspace, the Holdline voice-agent demo, Review Loop and the TMLP Statistics Platform.
  Sections: Vowbird.ai; Digistax; Holdline; Review Loop; TMLP Statistics Platform

## Projects

- [Vowbird.ai](https://vowbird.ai): A wedding planner that does the tedious parts for you: one shared guest list, RSVPs that chase themselves, and invitations where an assistant answers guest questions. Free in early access.
- Digistax: Founded in 2018 as a service automation firm; now a prototype software agency where every task runs as a graph of AI agents, with a person approving every price, merge, deploy and email. See the case study above.
- Holdline: A voice-agent proof of concept (POC) with a fictional airline. One ElevenLabs agent rebooks five passengers over concurrent Twilio calls (French and English, a handoff to a specialist agent, CRM context from Salesforce over MCP), while a separate inventory service guarantees no seat is promised twice. See the Holdline case study above.
